summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
summary_short.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…

summary_short.zh: caveman项目是一个针对Claude Code的提示工程技巧，通过模仿原始人说话方式（如用'few token'代替'few tokens'）大幅削减token用量，解决大模型交互中token消耗过高的问题。核心原理是利用语言模型对精简表达的理解能力，去除冗余词汇后仍能保持输出质量，减少65%的token，证明并非所有任务都需要详细提示。作为Claude Code的自定义技能使用，适用于代码生成、快速摘要等场景，能有效降低API费用或响应延迟，是一个既有趣又实用的效率实验。
summary_short.en: The caveman project is a minimalist prompt strategy for Claude Code that cuts token usage by 65% using caveman-like speech, addressing high LLM costs. It works by stripping unnecessary words while maintaining output quality, showing that many prompts are overengineered. Apply it…
summary_short.es: The caveman project is a minimalist prompt strategy for Claude Code that cuts token usage by 65% using caveman-like speech, addressing high LLM costs. It works by stripping unnecessary words while maintaining output quality, showing that many prompts are overengineered. Apply it…

summary_short.zh: openclaude 是一个基于 TypeScript 的命令行 AI 代理，目标是“随处运行、随物可接”。它通过统一的终端接口，将不同模型、API 和工具组合在一起，降低多 AI 助手带来的割裂感。其最大特点是与具体供应商解耦，可灵活替换后端，并借助扩展机制融入现有开发流程。适合用于自动化复杂任务、在持续集成中调度智能体，或作为原型工具快速对比不同模型效果。你也可以把它当作脚手架，改造出贴合自己业务场景的专属 CLI 智能工具，从而更自主地控制数据流向与执行逻辑。
summary_short.en: openclaude is a TypeScript-based command-line AI agent designed to run across any environment and work with virtually any model, API, or tool. It solves the fragmentation of AI assistants by offering a single, portable interface for coding and automation tasks. Its key strength …
summary_short.es: openclaude is a TypeScript-based command-line AI agent designed to run across any environment and work with virtually any model, API, or tool. It solves the fragmentation of AI assistants by offering a single, portable interface for coding and automation tasks. Its key strength …

summary_short.zh: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。
summary_short.en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular …
